name: Cerebrolysin

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A preparation of low-molecular-weight peptides and amino acids produced by enzymatic breakdown of porcine brain tissue, registered in several countries for stroke and dementia. It has no FDA approval and is not a defined single molecule. Registered in several non-US jurisdictions. No FDA approval. Not a single defined molecular entity.
